corrections.corrected_title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY): Employment-Linked Incentive Scheme
corrections.authoritative_source: Press Information Bureau (PIB) / Union Cabinet Resolution (Ministry of Labour & Employment)

substantive_parameters.employment_target: 3.5 Crore formal jobs (1.92 Crore first-time entrants)
substantive_parameters.part_a_benefit: 1 month EPF wage up to ₹15,000 in 2 instalments (at 6m & 12m)
substantive_parameters.part_b_benefit: Up to ₹3,000/month per additional employee for 2 years (4 years for mfg)

provenance_history.correction_reason: Coaching note published unverified pre-Cabinet draft estimates (~₹1.07 Lakh Cr). Official Cabinet sanction is ₹99,446 Cr (discrepancy of ₹7,554 Cr corrected).
